guidelines: No telemetry, system logs, or status indicators in the user interface.
Strict padding guidelines: 16px (p-4) on mobile stacking, rounded-2xl / rounded-3xl corners.
Direct action buttons over complicated nested settings.
Full dark mode support with color inversion.

stateManagement.auth: AuthContext.tsx (Supports Firebase Auth, auto local-user generation if offline)
stateManagement.data: DataContext.tsx (State manager for sync, provides transactions, categories, debts, shopping items, events, loyalty cards)

aiEngine.architecture: Hybrid Dual-Engine AI (Google Gemini + Terra Local Engine)

localMode.trigger: Activated automatically if no API Key is provided or upon HTTP 429/503 (GEMINI38_FLASH_OVERLOAD)

features.regexParsing: Direct extraction of transaction amounts, note text, shopping lists, and tomorrow calendars.
features.financialAdvisor: Scans context.transactions to build local budgeting summaries and financial advice offline.
